page.notes: The first paragraph opens with an ornament before "Altera", read as the reference mark 1, which is printed beside the marginal note. The letters in the first line of the Bellarminus quotation and in the "hdeliter" word of the first paragraph are uncertain, and the latter is marked [?]. The word "Ovis" and other spellings are as printed. The large initial "T" of "Riplex" is joined to it. The line "re-cludere" is hyphenated across the line end and its hyphen is kept as printed. Figures and watermarks at the bottom right and the bullet points on the page are not printed text and are left out.
